evidence: 01_quantify.sh uses -l SR (stranded, forward); libraries are unstranded. With -l SR, reverse-orientation fragments are discarded: for RS79 the assigned fragments are 45195 with -l SR versus 90599 with -l U (with -l U the compatible fragment ratio is 1.0 for RS19).
02_merge_counts.py sums NumReads (estimated counts) over all transcripts of each gene, and reindexes to every gene_id.

Every column of gene_counts_merged.tsv matches the salmon quantification of the FASTQ listed for that sample_id in samples.tsv (exact match for 11 columns; RS79 column is from the RS79 file, see matrix_all_reads).
RS79 column of gene_counts_merged.tsv holds about one third of the reads of RS79.fastq.gz (column sum 14841 vs 45195 for all reads); the other 11 columns are complete.
03_de.py uses design "~condition"; the library-prep session is put in the metadata but not in the model.
DeseqStats contrast ["condition","treated","vehicle"]; log2fc is positive when expression is higher in treated cells (checked against raw treated/vehicle means).
padj is Benjamini-Hochberg over the tested genes (pydeseq2); recomputing BH from the draft pvalue column reproduces padj over the 799 tested genes.

Rerunning 03_de.py on gene_counts_merged.tsv and samples.tsv as shipped does not reproduce de_draft.tsv: log2fc differs by up to 2.25 and padj by up to 0.89 (rerun gives 3 genes at padj<0.05, draft gives 0).
